package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for template_parse_in_hot_path: html/template or text/template parse calls observed on request-style paths instead of startup-time caching.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
type ReportRow struct {
	Label string
	Value float64
}

func RenderRows(rows []ReportRow) []string {
	var results []string
	for _, row := range rows {
		tmpl := template.Must(template.New("row").Parse("<tr><td>{{.Label}}</td><td>{{.Value}}</td></tr>"))
		var buf strings.Builder
		if err := tmpl.Execute(&buf, row); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		results = append(results, buf.String())
	}
	return results
}

func FormatNotifications(items []string) ([]string, error) {
	var output []string
	for _, item := range items {
		t := template.Must(template.New("msg").Parse(fmt.Sprintf(`<p>Notification: %s</p>`, item)))
		var buf strings.Builder
		_ = t.Execute(&buf, nil)
		output = append(output, buf.String())
	}
	return output, nil
}
